best_safe_coverage: max coverage among wrong<=5% & unsafe<=20% thresholds
candidate_rule: deploy-all-valid sentinel (min-1); all midpoints between sorted unique finite score values; abstain-all sentinel (max+1)
selection_objective: tie-break: lower unsafe, lower wrong, more conservative (higher) threshold, canonical threshold value

unique_information_criterion.requirement: V1_FULL_PASS = YES AND (S1_FULL_PASS = NO OR V1_BSC - S1_BSC >= 0.05)
